# NCronJob

NCronJob is an in-process .NET job scheduler built on top of `IHostedService`.

Preferred docs:
- Human docs home: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/
- Getting started: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/getting-started/
- Documentation map: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/documentation-map/
- Agent and automation guide: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/agent-guide/

Compact Markdown reference:
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NCronJob-Dev/NCronJob/main/docs/llms-full.md

Important feature docs:
- Recurring jobs: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/features/define-and-schedule-jobs/
- Minimal API: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/features/minimal-api/
- Instant jobs: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/features/instant-jobs/
- Dependencies: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/features/model-dependencies/
- Conditional scheduling: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/features/conditional-job-scheduling/
- Dynamic job control: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/advanced/dynamic-job-control/
- Known gotchas: https://docs.ncronjob.dev/advanced/known-gotchas/

Repository samples:
- Minimal sample: https://github.com/NCronJob-Dev/NCronJob/tree/main/sample/MinimalSample
- Full sample: https://github.com/NCronJob-Dev/NCronJob/tree/main/sample/NCronJobSample
- Startup job sample: https://github.com/NCronJob-Dev/NCronJob/tree/main/sample/RunOnceSample
